h: Peller and Jarvis reportedly clash again, this time over her younger sister
p: A fresh argument between the streamers has reportedly spilled online, with the couple disagreeing over her younger sister and where family boundaries should lie. It follows their live-stream fight and the decision to block each other earlier this week.
more: Peller recently said he needs to grow into a man after the first clash.
The pair are two months into their marriage.
